result.note: Official CPI release; tested direction, the revamped-index record and the cited drivers.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's retail inflation data for May 2026, released in June 2026:
items: Retail inflation eased in May 2026 compared with the previous reading.
At 3.93%, the May 2026 figure was the highest recorded under the revamped index, with fuel price hikes and a weak rupee cited as drivers.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because retail inflation rose, not eased, to 3.93% in May 2026, the highest under the revamped index. Fuel hikes and a weak rupee imported price pressure ahead of an uncertain monsoon.
questions.source: India's retail inflation rose to 3.93% in May, its highest under the revamped index, as fuel hikes and a weak rupee imported price pressure ahead of an uncertain monsoon.
